invariants.name: pseudoreplication_threshold
invariants.description: Minimum number of biological replicates required per experimental condition for pseudobulk differential expression
invariants.rationale: At least 2 biological replicates per group are needed to estimate within-group biological dispersion for negative binomial GLM (PyDESeq2). Below this threshold, statistical inference is mathematically undefined.

invariants.name: spatial_spots_minimum
invariants.description: Minimum number of spatial spots required for neighborhood graph construction and spatial inference
invariants.rationale: Spatial neighborhood graphs require a minimum number of spots to construct meaningful connectivity structures. Below 5 spots, Moran's I and other spatial statistics become unstable.

invariants.name: fdr_alpha_threshold
invariants.description: Minimum FDR (False Discovery Rate) alpha threshold for multiple testing correction
invariants.rationale: Standard Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control at 5% is the conventional threshold for statistical significance in high-throughput genomics. Capabilities requiring multiple testing warrant use this as the minimum acceptable alpha.

invariants.name: annotation_marker_consistency_threshold
invariants.description: Minimum positive-marker consistency score required for SUPPORTED annotation verdict
invariants.rationale: At least 60% of positive markers must show coherent expression within the labeled population to support the label. This balances sensitivity to true markers against noise tolerance.

invariants.name: annotation_negative_marker_violation_max
invariants.description: Maximum allowed negative-marker violation rate for annotation evidence
invariants.rationale: No more than 20% of lineage-exclusive negative markers may be expressed. Exceeding this indicates the label violates lineage exclusivity constraints.

invariants.name: annotation_reference_mapping_min
invariants.description: Minimum reference mapping score required for independent identity evidence
invariants.rationale: Reference atlas mapping confidence must reach 0.70 to serve as an independent identity source. Below this, the mapping is too uncertain to anchor a cell-type identity claim.

invariants.name: annotation_cross_method_agreement_min
invariants.description: Minimum cross-method agreement score for independent identity evidence
invariants.rationale: When multiple independent annotation methods agree at >= 0.80, this serves as an alternative to reference mapping for establishing label identity. Higher threshold compensates for method-specific biases.

invariants.name: annotation_doublet_rate_max
invariants.description: Maximum allowed doublet rate within a labeled population
invariants.rationale: If more than 15% of cells in a labeled population are predicted doublets, the population may be a doublet artifact rather than a genuine biological cluster.

invariants.name: causal_language_pattern
invariants.description: Regex pattern detecting prohibited causal/mechanistic language in scientific claims
invariants.rationale: These keywords indicate causal or mechanistic claims that exceed the warrant of observational/associative evidence classes. Detection blocks the claim as not-warranted.

invariants.name: causal_de_overclaim_patterns
invariants.description: Regex patterns detecting false causal treatment DE claims from marker gene analysis
current_value: caused/induced + N DEGs + without replicates/at single-cell level
invariants.rationale: Marker p-values from single-cell rank_genes_groups cannot be cited as causal treatment condition DE p-values. These patterns detect the specific linguistic forms of this common overclaim.

invariants.name: spatial_robustness_ladder
invariants.description: Canonical validity ladder for spatial inference verdicts with degradation semantics
invariants.rationale: ROBUST requires all canonical controls tested+passing AND permutation null. SUPPORTED requires all provided controls pass but no permutation null. FRAGILE is the honest default when any alternative is UNTESTED. ABSTAIN when a control FAILED or no controls provided.

invariants.name: spatial_core_controls
invariants.description: Canonical alternative-explanation controls that MUST be addressed before a spatial conclusion can exceed FRAGILE
invariants.rationale: These three confounds are the most common non-biological explanations for spatial enrichment patterns. Without addressing them, the observation may reflect measurement geometry rather than biology.

invariants.name: spatial_canonical_alternatives
invariants.description: Complete registry of canonical alternative explanations for spatial observations
invariants.rationale: These 12 alternative explanations represent the known non-biological confounds in spatial transcriptomics. The registry is part of the capability contract and may only change with a contract version bump.

invariants.name: pseudoreplication_detection_pattern
invariants.description: Detection logic for cell-level pseudoreplication in differential expression analysis
invariants.current_value: BFA-001: DE call at cell level with condition groupby but no pseudobulk aggregation marker
invariants.rationale: Condition-level inference performed on cell-level observations without biological replicate aggregation treats thousands of cells from one sample as independent, inflating false discovery rates.

invariants.name: cell_type_hallucination_patterns
invariants.description: Regex patterns detecting unverified cell-type assertions from numeric cluster IDs
current_value: concluded that cluster N is/are [cell type]
invariants.rationale: Unsupervised clusters must remain numeric unless verified against ground truth reference markers. These patterns detect the linguistic forms of cell-type hallucination from cluster IDs.

invariants.name: annotation_verdict_ladder
invariants.description: Deterministic verdict ladder for cell annotation evidence assessment
invariants.rationale: SUPPORTED requires multiple independent evidence classes cohere. TENTATIVE indicates partial evidence or at least one class missing/weak. ABSTAIN means no evidence, contradictory evidence, or open-set population.

invariants.name: spatial_coordinate_audit_min_spots
invariants.description: Minimum spots threshold for spatial coordinate audit grading
invariants.rationale: Spatial coordinate audit returns grade C (fail) when fewer than min_spots (default 5) are present. This aligns with the capability precondition for spatial graph construction.
